Private Function Bits(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If VarType(v) = vbDouble Then
        Dim d As Double: d = v
        Bits = "D:" & Format(d, "0.000000000000000E+00")
    Else
        Bits = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Done:

Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description

End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
